findings.title: Reducing segment count hides an option that blocks export
findings.why_it_matters: After marking segment 4 optional, changing the expected count to 3 leaves an invisible optional position in the recipe. Even when all three visible segments and the selected position are valid, validation blocks preview, downloads and saving; the user must discover that increasing the count again reveals the checkbox that needs clearing. Updating dependent positions when the count changes avoids trapping an otherwise valid configuration behind an invisible setting.
findings.suggested_fix: For an accepted valid segment count, filter optionalEmpty to positions below that count and clamp the selected index into range in the same change callback. Preserve temporary invalid numeric input as draft state if needed. Add a browser regression that checks segment 4 as optional, reduces count to 3 and successfully previews/saves a three-segment source without re-expanding the count.
evidence: src/ui/TextRecipeSettings.tsx:22 -- <input type="number" min={1} max={100} value={recipe.segments} onChange={(e) => change({ ...recipe, segments: Number(e.target.value) })} />
Trigger: configure segments=4, index=0, optionalEmpty=[3], then set Expected segment count to 3. The change callback keeps optionalEmpty=[3].
src/ui/TextRecipeSettings.tsx:31 -- {Array.from({ length: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, recipe.segments)) }, (_, index) => ( -- renders only indices 0 through 2, hiding the retained optional position 3.
src/engine/validation.ts:86 -- (r.index >= r.segments || r.optionalEmpty.some((i) => i >= r.segments) || -- rejects the hidden position, producing split-index even if every visible setting is valid.
